title: Spectral Intertwining Operators
summary: We study spectral intertwining operators between spectral Eisenstein series $\operatorname{Eis}_{P^\vee}$, $\operatorname{Eis}_{Q^\vee}$ for two parabolic subgroups $P, Q$ of a $p$-adic reductive group $G$ with the same Levi subgroup $M$, inspired by the analogy with the classical intertwining operators between parabolic induced representations of $p$-adic reductive groups.
